candidate: Three genuine HGS populations produce exact-model elites. Feasible routes from 24 elite solutions are pooled and an exact set-partitioning model selects one cover of all customers. The complete ReSETP scorer retains the recombination only if it strictly improves the best parent.
control: Best exact full-model parent among the same HGS populations and elites.
gate: Across three development cases, route-pool recombination must have zero losses by construction and at least one strict improvement over the best exact parent; every selected solution must pass the independent full checker.
stop: If no case improves, stop the current route-pool regime. Do not enlarge the pool, time, or cases to rescue it.
claim_boundary: Seen development cases and one seed. Passing only authorizes a fresh replicate-03 gate.
